tx:
▸ Decanter
One fast method to obtain vials is via decanting. The player can take a noted stack of 2–4 dose potions to a decanter, decant those potions into 1-dose potions, and then decant the potions back into the 2–4 dose versions. This will result in the original noted 2–4 dose potions and a number of noted empty vials. The player should then deposit the empty vials into their bank to repeat the process – otherwise, decanting into 1-dose potions will use the empty vials. The decanter will charge you per vial supplied.
Note that this method will not work if "Destroy empty vials when decanting potions" option is checked under Settings -> Interfaces -> Inventory.
▸ Members
Two vials spawn in Frincos's Fabulous Herb Store in south-west Entrana as well as a house in Mort'ton. The respawn rate is two every two minutes. A vial is also obtained through the Swept Away quest.
A large variety of shops sell vials and vial packs, both empty and water filled. Obtaining empty vials this way is generally more expensive than the fee for decanting.
▸ Non-members
Even though vials are mostly used in Herblore (a members-only skill past level 5), they are not a members-only item. One way to obtain a vial for non-members is by having the apothecary make a strength potion for the player. The player needs to supply him with a limpwurt root and red spiders' eggs, and pay him 5 coins. The player can empty this vial or drink all the doses of the potion to obtain an empty vial. However, the potion itself is worth more than the empty vial.
After the partial completion of Visions of Havenhythe, the player can interact with the vial cabinet on the of the Wendlewick lighthouse to obtain up to 6 free vials at a time.…
Using the Crafting skill, members can make their own vials. This requires level 33 Crafting, a glassblowing pipe and molten glass.
sc: However, the player can use the drop trick to obtain more vials in a single run.
A water trough is conveniently nearby in the balcony to the east, making this one of the best ways to obtain vials of water (which also do not count towards the 6-vial limit) in non-members worlds.
